Four reviewers, 38 raw findings, deduplicated to **24 distinct issues**. Sorted by priority. File references are absolute: `C:\Users\18054\kre8r\src\routes\id8r.js` and `C:\Users\18054\kre8r\public\id8r.html`.

## CRITICAL (creator loses work — fix before anything else)

### C1. Checkpoint recovery banner is structurally broken — interrupted research is unrecoverable
**Merged: id8r-1 + ID8R-008 + id8r-04.** Highest-confidence finding in the entire review — three independent reviewers landed on it.
Backend writes checkpoints as `{ ...session, researchResults: { youtube, data, vault } }` (id8r.js ~858-861, 893-896, 932-935). Frontend `checkForCheckpoint()` reads `cp.data.phase1/phase2/phase3` — keys the current backend NEVER writes. After a real mid-research server restart: `phasesFound` is empty, "Show saved research" renders nothing, completion never registers. The creator is told work was saved, sees an empty feed. Direct Prime Directive violation. The `getOrRestoreSession` migration shim (lines 89-96) is the smoking gun — it remaps the old shape, proving the format drifted and the frontend was never updated.
**Fix:** Update `checkForCheckpoint()` to read `cp.data.researchResults?.youtube/.data/.vault` (keep a legacy `phaseN` fallback to match the backend shim). Fix `phasesFound`, the rebuild loop, and the completion check (`researchResults?.vault`). Then kill the server mid-research and confirm the banner rebuilds the feed.

### C2. send-pipeline can clobber a complete project brief with nulls
**id8r-6.** Guard at line 1123 passes if EITHER `briefData` OR `packageData` exists. When `existingProjectId` is set, line 1150 unconditionally calls `db.updateProjectId8r(project.id, { ...briefData, researchSummary, citations })` — a full overwrite of `id8r_data`. If the session has packageData but no brief (or a checkpoint restore failed to rehydrate briefData), it silently destroys a previously-saved `chosenConcept`/`researchSummary`/`briefData` on that project. Recovery path destroys the thing it's meant to protect.
**Fix:** When `existingProjectId` is set, read-merge into existing `id8r_data` (spread, replace only non-null fields), or hard-require `briefData` before allowing attach to an existing project.

## HIGH (broken behavior, lost research signal, or core redesign blocker)

### H1. Research SSE stream is fire-and-forget — dropped connection strands the creator
**id8r-2.** `streamSSE()` `pump()` `done` branch returns silently. If the body ends without a `done` event (proxy timeout, crash, network blip, tab throttle), `researchComplete` stays false, "Package This" stays disabled forever, no error shown. Compounds C1 — a dropped stream with a broken recovery banner = total dead-end.
**Fix:** In the `done` branch, if `researchComplete` is still false, surface a retry/resume affordance. Add a watchdog that flips to an error state if no `done`/`error` arrives within N seconds of the last event.

### H2. Concept/hook generation ignores the 190-transcript voice calibration WritΩr uses
**ID8R-001.** Id8Ωr writes hooks ("first 15 seconds script") off a one-line `voiceSummary` string while WritΩr injects `loadVoiceCalibrationBlock()` (from `data/voice-calibration.json`) + REALITY_RULE/SLOP_RULE. The hook — the single most load-bearing artifact Id8Ωr produces — is the one place the real voice model is absent. Creator picks a hook in Package; WritΩr then rewrites it against the calibrated voice, so the chosen hook gets discarded downstream. Wasted decision.
**Fix:** Hoist `loadVoiceCalibrationBlock` (ideally into `src/utils/claude.js`) and append it to system prompts in `/fast-concepts`, `/concepts`, `/package`, `/brief`. Closes the loop so WritΩr keeps the hook instead of reworking it.

### H3. Post-Mortem brief never injected into ideation (known issue #5)
**Merged: IT-1 + ID8R-005.** Id8Ωr already injects MirrΩr evals, ClipsΩr patterns, Studio Intel, content_intelligence, and the VectΩr brief via `getActiveBrief()`. It never calls `db.getActivePostMortemBrief()` (`src/db.js:6128`) — architecturally identical to the VectΩr injection sitting right beside it. The one tool whose entire purpose is "what to avoid next time" has no path back into ideation. Highest-leverage missing input, and the fix is copy-paste from the adjacent VectΩr block.
**Fix:** In `/fast-concepts` and `/concepts`, after the `getActiveBrief()` injection, add a null-safe try/catch calling `getActivePostMortemBrief()` and append a "LAST POST-MORTEM (avoid repeating): root_cause / adjustments / avoid" block. Instruct the model not to regenerate concepts matching the Avoid list without materially different execution.

### H4. Grounded research citations never shown to the creator
**ID8R-002.** Gemini grounding returns cited source URLs; they're captured, stored on `session.citations`, propagated to project-context and consumed by WritΩr/MailΩr — but the Id8Ωr UI renders only prose + a "🔍 Live" badge. Zero citation rendering (grep confirms). The creator repeats statistics on camera with no way to verify them. Undercuts the entire "go on camera confident" goal.
**Fix:** Include per-phase `*_sources` in the `phase_result` SSE payload (already on `results.*_sources`) and render a compact clickable "Sources" list under each phase card. Surface top 3-5 domains next to the Live badge.

### H5. SeedΩr→Id8Ωr handoff drops cluster, connections, notes, brief_data
**IT-2.** The handoff is client-side only (`handleIdeaSeed()`): it flattens ONLY title/concept/hook into a textarea blob + sets the angle dropdown. The backend has no `idea_id` param and never reads the idea record — so ConstellΩr cluster context, the weighted connection graph, and the creator's own notes are thrown away at the exact moment they'd most help find the angle. 4 of ~8 meaningful fields survive.
**Fix:** Add an optional `idea_id` param to `/fast-concepts`; server-side load via `db.getIdea(idea_id)`, build an injection block from cluster + resolved connection titles + notes, append to the concept prompt. Persist `idea_id` on the session for the H6/round-trip fix below.

### H6. Two parallel concept-generation paths duplicate ~150 lines — and the conversational path adds a whole decision
**Merged: id8r-01 + id8r-05 (mode-decision portion).** `/fast-concepts` (new default, 5 concepts) and the retained `/start → /respond → /concepts` path (3 concepts) rebuild nearly identical prompt context (intelligence/mirrr/vectr/studio blocks). The conversational path is reachable only via a de-emphasized link yet carries equal maintenance weight AND forces a multi-turn Q&A before any concept appears — the exact friction the redesign targets.
**Fix:** Commit to fast-concepts as the single entry. Immediately extract shared prompt assembly into one `buildConceptContext()` helper called by both. Once fast-pass is confirmed default, delete `/start`, `/respond`, `/concepts` and the conversation screen.

## MEDIUM

### M1. callClaudeText assumes content[0] is a text block — hard 500 on tool_use/empty/truncated
**id8r-3.** Line 209: `data.content[0].text.trim()`. With web-search tools the first block can be `tool_use` (no `.text`); a `max_tokens` stop or refusal yields an empty/absent block → TypeError. Powers `/start`, `/respond`, `/concepts`, `/package`, `/brief`, the Phase 4 summarizer, and the Gemini→Claude fallback. Surfaces as a hard 500 on all but the summarizer.
**Fix:** `const block = (data.content||[]).find(b => b.type==='text'); return (block?.text||'').trim();` — throw a clear "Claude returned no text" error if empty so callers handle a known condition.

### M2. callClaudeJSON dies on any malformed JSON — whole generation step lost, no repair
**id8r-13.** Lines 212-218 strip one fenced block then `JSON.parse`; any trailing comma, prose preamble the regex misses, or `max_tokens` truncation (package=2048, brief=4096) → hard 500, creator loses an already-paid generation. `/brief` is the final pre-pipeline step — a truncated brief strands the user, and the brief screen has no retry button.
**Fix:** Before throwing, extract the largest balanced `{...}` substring and re-parse; on `max_tokens` stop_reason, retry once with higher tokens. At minimum return a structured error and add a one-click retry to the brief screen.

### M3. Phase 1 Gemini grounding sources are silently dropped
**id8r-5.** Phase 1 stores `results.youtube_sources` (line 849) but never merges into `session.citations`; only Phase 2 sets it (line 883). If Phase 2 falls back to Claude training (`sources=[]`) while Phase 1 grounded real URLs, the project ends with ZERO citations despite live research — the "Live" badge lies.
**Fix:** Accumulate: `session.citations = dedup([...(p1.sources||[]), ...(p2.sources||[])])`.

### M4. Phase 3 VaultΩr overlap match is polluted by boilerplate → false "already covered" warnings
**Merged: id8r-8 + ID8R-004.** Keywords come from the full labeled `conceptBrief` (`Concept:... | Angle:... | Why it works:... | Context:...`) split on `length>4` (line 912), so label/filler words ('concept','angle','works','context','video','about','homestead') match nearly any footage. Plus substring `includes()` causes spurious hits ('cost'→'costume'). The dedup signal is noisy enough the creator learns to ignore it — adds doubt, violates Secondary Directive.
**Fix:** Build keywords from the chosen concept's headline/angle only (not the labeled string), apply a stopword list incl. label words, require word-boundary (`\b`) matches, and require ≥2 matching keywords before flagging "related." Rank by match count.

### M5. content_angle written into the wrong project column; format dropped entirely
**IT-5.** `/send-pipeline` calls `db.updateProjectPipr({ content_type: pb.content_angle })` (~1145) — the ANGLE goes into the `content_type` field while the actual format (`pb.content_type`: short_form/long_form/series) is never persisted. Anything routing short/long-form on `content_type` gets an angle string.
**Fix:** Write `pb.content_type` to the format column; store `pb.content_angle` in `high_concept_angles` (already exists). Audit PipΩr's read of `content_type`.

### M6. Original seed idea can fall out of the prompt window in long conversations
**ID8R-006.** `getRecentMessages` keeps `messages.slice(0,2)` + last 6 exchanges. But `slice(0,2)` is the synthetic "Let's get started." pair, NOT the creator's first substantive message (index 2+). In a long Shape-It session the founding idea is windowed out, so `/package`/`/brief` can drift from what the creator started with. "Never break the creative thread" risk.
**Fix:** Pin the creator's first real user message (`messages.find(m => m.role==='user' && m.content!=="Let's get started.")`) into `/package`/`/brief` prompts as a fixed "Original idea:" line, independent of the rolling window.

### M7. SSE contract mismatches: phase_note dead, retry toast shows wrong timing
**Merged: id8r-4 (retry/phase_note portions).** Backend emits `phase_note` (lines 850/884) with no frontend handler. The retry toast reads `ev.delay_ms`/`ev.attempt` but the backend `retrying` event (803-806) sends neither — so during real rate-limit backoff (up to 16s, attempt 4) the creator sees a misleading "2000ms / attempt 1" countdown.
**Fix:** Add `delay_ms` and `attempt` to the `retrying` payload. Drop the unused `phase_note` emits or add a handler.

### M8. Research is unconditional and uncached — re-choosing re-pays full Gemini latency
**Merged: ID8R-009 + id8r-09.** Pick A → research → blend → pick B re-runs all 3 passes + synthesis from scratch; nothing keyed/cached by concept. No skip path for a creator who already knows their angle. The slowest gate in the tool is mandatory, and `/package` already tolerates "No research data."
**Fix:** Cache Phase 1/2 on the session keyed by a hash of `conceptBrief`; short-circuit if unchanged. Add a "Skip research → Package now" action on the concepts screen.

### M9. Package step forces three single-selects before a brief can generate
**id8r-05 (package portion).** `checkPkg()` keeps `package-continue-btn` disabled until title AND thumbnail AND hook are all chosen — the densest decision cluster in the flow, on the first screen after the marquee fast path.
**Fix:** Pre-select the AI-ranked best of each so continue is enabled immediately; let the creator override only on disagreement. Path drops from ~8 decisions to ~2.

### M10. Manual "Save to Vault" makes the creator responsible for persistence
**id8r-08.** The brief screen leans on a manual "💡 Save to Vault" button while send-pipeline + checkpoints already persist everything. It adds a decision and risks the creator thinking work is lost if unclicked — contradicts both Directives.
**Fix:** Auto-save the brief to the originating SeedΩr idea (or create one) as soon as the brief renders; show a passive "Saved" indicator. Keep the explicit control only as a redundant affordance.

### M11. send-pipeline writes the same payload three times (DB / project-context.json / vault files)
**id8r-07.** `db.updateProjectId8r()`, `addId8rContext()`, and separate vault files all store the same blob. Consumers read inconsistently (WritΩr reads both DB + context; MailΩr/Lab read only DB). Three sources of truth → schema drift risk on every future change.
**Fix:** Make `project-context.json` canonical (the stated single source of truth); have WritΩr/MailΩr/Lab read it via one shared loader. Keep `id8r_data` only as a cheap DB-queryable copy for Mission Control. Reduce vault files to the human-readable README + conversation log.

## LOW

### L1. fast-concepts choice ids 4/5 silently discarded → research runs on an empty concept
**id8r-9.** `/choose` clamps numeric choices to `[1,3]` (line 728) but fast-concepts produces 5 concepts. Choosing card 4 or 5 falls through to the free-text "blend" branch, creating a Custom Direction with `headline="4"` and empty angle/why/hook. **Fix:** accept `choiceNum >= 1 && choiceNum <= concepts.length`; only blend on non-numeric input. *(Real bug despite low severity — verify before downgrading.)*

### L2. /merge never persists a checkpoint — merge sessions aren't crash-safe
**id8r-10.** `/merge` (1353-1370) calls `sessions.set()` but never `persistSession()`, unlike `/start`/`/fast-concepts`. A restart before choose/research loses the already-paid merge concepts. **Fix:** add `persistSession(sessionId);` after `sessions.set()`.

### L3. rescue redirect uses `?project=` but canonical param is `?load_project=`
**id8r-7.** The last-ditch rescue redirects to `/pipr.html?project=${id}` while send-pipeline uses `?load_project=${id}` (line 1233). If PipΩr reads `load_project`, the rescue lands on an empty PipΩr — the safety net fails. **Fix:** change to `?load_project=`, or confirm pipr.html accepts both.

### L4. SeedΩr round-trip not closed — promoted ideas stay "untouched"
**Merged: ID8R-011 + IT-3.** `/send-pipeline` creates a project but never sets `ideas.project_id`/`status` (it doesn't receive `idea_id`), and `saveToVault()` omits `researchSummary`/`citations` from `brief_data`. A researched, promoted idea still shows as untouched in SeedΩr, inviting duplicate ideation. **Fix:** thread `idea_id` (per H5) into send-pipeline; on project creation set `ideas.project_id` + `status='in_production'`. Include researchSummary/citations in `saveToVault()`'s brief_data.

### L5. Dead phase_wait / MUSINGS countdown UI + orphaned sseWait()
**Merged: id8r-02 + ID8R-003 + the phase_wait half of id8r-4.** ~90 lines of frontend (MUSINGS array, countdown, progress bar, "Skip wait" button, CSS 263-275) gated on `ev.stage==='phase_wait'`, which the backend never emits. `sseWait()` (line 752) is its never-called counterpart. Also a copy mismatch — the research header still promises "each one needs a moment to breathe." **Fix:** delete the phase_wait branch, MUSINGS, countdown logic, CSS, and `sseWait()`. (Reviewers unanimous: delete, don't wire up — the fast flow is better without an artificial pause.)

### L6. Dead callClaudeWithSearchFallback (~40 lines + doc comment)
**id8r-03.** Defined at line 280 (+ doc at 221), never called — Phases 1/2 migrated to `callGeminiWithFallback`. **Fix:** remove it, unless intentionally wiring it as a tertiary fallback after Gemini + Claude-training.

### L7. Studio Intel age label renders "NaNd ago" into prompts
**id8r-11.** Lines 483/649: if `si.created_at` is missing/unparseable, `ageHours` is NaN and renders "NaNd ago" into the system prompt. **Fix:** `const ts = Date.parse(si.created_at); const ageHours = Number.isFinite(ts) ? Math.floor((Date.now()-ts)/3600000) : null;` — omit the label when null.

### L8. Concept-count copy/grid mismatch
**ID8R-007.** Fast-pass returns 5 but the header hardcodes "Three directions" and `.concept-grid` is `repeat(3,1fr)` — 5 cards wrap 3+2 awkwardly under wrong copy. **Fix:** dynamic header from `conceptsData.length`; grid `repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))`.

### L9. Inline checkpoints spread the full live session, diverging from persistSession shape
**id8r-12.** Lines 857/892/931 call `setCheckpoint(..., { ...session, researchResults })` directly, spreading systemPrompt, full messages, and transient flags (`restoredFromCheckpoint`) — this divergence is the root cause behind C1's format drift. **Fix:** set `session.researchResults` then call `persistSession()` so on-disk shape is always canonical. *(Fix this alongside C1 — same root cause.)*

### L10. Unused `path` import
**id8r-06.** `const path = require('path')` at line 21, never used. **Fix:** remove it.

### L11. (Strategic, no creative-state risk) VectΩr can't see Id8Ωr's accumulated research
**IT-4.** Research reaches WritΩr/MailΩr but VectΩr (a producer into Id8Ωr via getActiveBrief) never consumes it — the strategy↔research loop is one-directional. **Fix (low priority):** when VectΩr builds a session, roll up recent projects' `id8r_data.researchSummary` + citation domains. No state loss if absent.

## TOP 3 BY CREATOR IMPACT

1. **C1 — Broken checkpoint recovery banner.** This is the worst kind of failure: the system promises recovery, the creator trusts it, and it silently delivers nothing. Three reviewers independently flagged it. It defeats the Prime Directive on the exact failure mode (mid-research restart) the whole checkpoint system exists to handle. Fix it with L9 in one pass.

2. **H4 — Invisible research citations.** The creator stands in front of a camera repeating statistics with no way to verify them. The data is already captured and stored — it's purely a rendering gap. Highest confidence-to-effort ratio for trust in the core deliverable.

3. **H2 + H3 — Voice calibration + Post-Mortem injection into concepts.** These are the two highest-leverage *missing inputs* to the most load-bearing artifact (the hook/concept). H2 stops WritΩr from discarding the creator's chosen hook; H3 stops the creator from repeating a diagnosed mistake one idea later. Both are near copy-paste from existing adjacent code. Together they make the idea stage actually learn from the rest of the pipeline.

## VERDICT ON THE REDESIGN (cut mind map, fast concept pass first)

**Right call. Ship it — but finish the job.**

The code confirms the diagnosis. The mind map is already gone, and `/fast-concepts` exists as the new default. The remaining friction the redesign is chasing is real and visible in the code: the conversational `/start → /respond → /concepts` path forces a multi-turn Q&A before a single concept appears (H6), and the package step stacks three forced single-selects before a brief can generate (M9). Both add decisions with no proportional payoff — exactly what the Secondary Directive says to cut.

But the redesign is currently **half-landed, and the seams are where the bugs live:**

- The two paths now duplicate ~150 lines of prompt assembly (H6) and produce different concept counts (5 vs 3), which has already spawned a real bug — choosing card 4 or 5 silently discards the concept (L1) — plus the copy/grid mismatch (L8).
- The checkpoint format drifted during the migration and the frontend was never updated (C1/L9) — the single most dangerous bug in the review is a direct artifact of the incomplete redesign.

**Recommended sequence:**
1. Land the safety fixes first: **C1+L9, C2, H1** — the redesign is moving state-handling code around, so harden recovery before adding more flow changes.
2. Commit fully to fast-concepts: extract `buildConceptContext()` (H6), fix the choice-range bug (L1), delete `/start`/`/respond`/`/concepts` and the dead phase_wait machinery (L5).
3. Then the high-value enrichment that makes the fast pass actually better than the slow one: voice calibration (H2), Post-Mortem injection (H3), visible citations (H4), auto-selected package picks (M9), skip-research shortcut (M8).

Cutting the mind map and the conversational pre-amble is correct. The risk isn't the direction — it's stopping at "fast path exists" while the old path, its duplicated prompt code, and the drifted checkpoint shape all linger. The fast pass isn't done until the conversational path is deleted and recovery is verified by killing the server mid-research.

## Full Findings (38 total)

### [HIGH] Checkpoint recovery banner reads phase1/phase2/phase3 keys that the current code never writes — research is silently unrecoverable
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 858-861, 893-896, 932-935; public/id8r.html checkForCheckpoint() (phasesFound/PHASE_LABELS/[1,2,3].forEach reading cp.data['phase'+ph])
**Problem:** The /research endpoint writes its crash-safe checkpoints in the shape `{ ...session, researchResults: { youtube, data, vault } }` (id8r.js lines 858-861, 893-896, 932-935). But the frontend checkpoint-recovery banner (`checkForCheckpoint`, id8r.html) reads `cp.data.phase1`, `cp.data.phase2`, `cp.data.phase3` to decide what survived and to rebuild the research feed. Those `phaseN` keys are NEVER written by the current backend. So after a real server restart mid-research, the banner computes `phasesFound = ''` (empty), the 'Show saved research' button renders nothing, and `cp.data.phase3` is undefined so research is never marked complete. The creator's completed YouTube/Data research is on disk in the checkpoint but the only UI that surfaces it cannot read it. This is a direct violation of the Prime Directive: research state is lost from the user's point of view. The `getOrRestoreSession` migration block (lines 89-96) was clearly written for an older phase1/2/3 shape that no longer exists, confirming the format drifted and the frontend was never updated.
**Fix:** Make the frontend read the actual checkpoint shape: `cp.data.researchResults?.youtube/.data/.vault` instead of `cp.data.phase1/2/3`. Update phasesFound, the rebuild loop, and the completion check (`cp.data.researchResults?.vault`). Alternatively, have the backend write both shapes. Verify the migration block in getOrRestoreSession matches whatever shape is canonical.

### [HIGH] Research SSE stream is fire-and-forget on the client — no completion guarantee, lost research if connection drops
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.html streamSSE() pump() done branch (returns silently); onResearchEvent has no terminal-without-done handling
**Problem:** streamSSE() in id8r.html pumps the response body but has no handling for a stream that ends without ever sending `{stage:'done'}`. If the fetch body `done` becomes true before a 'done' event (proxy timeout, server crash mid-phase, network blip, browser tab throttling), `researchComplete` stays false and the 'Package This' button stays disabled forever — the creator is stuck on the research screen with completed-but-unusable research and no error shown (the `pump()` `done` branch just `return`s silently). The server-side global ping (8s) mitigates proxy timeouts but does nothing for an actual mid-stream disconnect. There is no client timeout, no 'stream ended unexpectedly' state, and no way to retry research without losing the chosen concept. Combined with finding id8r-1 (broken recovery banner), a dropped research stream strands the user.
**Fix:** In the `done` branch of pump(), if `researchComplete` is still false, surface an error/retry affordance (e.g. re-enable continue with a warning, or offer 'resume from checkpoint'). Add a watchdog timeout that flips to an error UI if no 'done'/'error' event arrives within N seconds of the last event.

### [MEDIUM] callClaudeText assumes content[0] is a text block — throws on tool_use / empty content, crashing summarization and all text calls
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js line 209 (callClaudeText: data.content[0].text.trim())
**Problem:** callClaudeText returns `data.content[0].text.trim()` (id8r.js line 209). The Anthropic API does not guarantee content[0] is a text block: with web-search tools the first block can be `tool_use` (no `.text`), and a stop_reason of `max_tokens` mid-tool or a refusal can yield an empty/absent first block. `data.content[0].text` would then be `undefined.trim()` → TypeError, or `content[0]` undefined → TypeError. This call path is used by /start, /respond, /concepts (via JSON), /package, /brief, the Phase 4 summarizer, and the Gemini->Claude fallback. callClaudeWithSearchFallback correctly filters `b.type==='text'`, but the Gemini fallback (callGeminiWithFallback line 276) routes to callClaudeText with no tools, so normally safe — but a truncated/empty response still throws instead of degrading gracefully. The Phase 4 try/catch catches it, but /start, /respond, /concepts, /package, /brief surface it as a hard 500.
**Fix:** Defensively extract text: `const block = (data.content||[]).find(b => b.type==='text'); return (block?.text||'').trim();` and throw a clear 'Claude returned no text' error if empty, so callers handle it as a known condition rather than a TypeError.

### [MEDIUM] Backend emits phase_note (never handled) and never emits phase_wait/delay_ms — retry toast and live-search badge are dead/broken
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 803-806 (retrying: no delay_ms/attempt), 850/884 (phase_note), 752 (sseWait dead); public/id8r.html onResearchEvent phase_wait block + retry toast reading ev.delay_ms/ev.attempt
**Problem:** Three SSE contract mismatches between /research and onResearchEvent: (1) Backend sends `{stage:'phase_note', message:'🔍 Live Google search'}` on Gemini success (lines 850, 884) but the frontend onResearchEvent has no `phase_note` handler — the live-search confirmation is silently dropped. The 'Live' source badge still works via phase_result.source, so phase_note is pure dead signal. (2) The frontend handles `ev.stage==='phase_wait'` with an entire countdown/musings UI (countdown-num, progress bar, skip button) but the backend NEVER sends phase_wait — that whole UI block is dead code, and `sseWait()` (line 752) is defined but never called. (3) The retry toast reads `ev.delay_ms` and `ev.attempt`, but the backend's retrying event (lines 803-806) sends only `{stage:'retrying', message}` — so the toast always shows the default 2000ms/'attempt 1' regardless of the real backoff (which can be 16s, attempt 4). The creator sees a misleading countdown during long rate-limit waits.
**Fix:** Add `delay_ms` and `attempt` fields to the retrying event payload so the toast is accurate. Remove dead phase_wait/sseWait code or wire it up. Drop the unused phase_note emits or add a handler.

### [MEDIUM] Gemini grounding sources are dropped for Phase 1 — only Phase 2 citations are persisted, weakening downstream citation injection
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js line 849 (results.youtube_sources set but never merged into session.citations); only line 883 sets citations
**Problem:** callGemini returns grounding source URLs. In /research, Phase 1 stores `results.youtube_sources` (line 849) but never assigns them to `session.citations`. Only Phase 2 sets `session.citations = p2.sources` (line 883). `session.citations` is what flows to db.updateProjectId8r and addId8rContext (send-pipeline lines 1155, 1165), which MailΩr reads for its citationsBlock. So any credible YouTube-landscape source URLs Gemini grounded in Phase 1 are silently discarded. Worse: if Phase 2 falls back to Claude training (source='training', sources=[]) while Phase 1 succeeded with live Gemini sources, the project ends up with ZERO citations even though live research with real URLs occurred. The 'Live' badge tells the creator the research was grounded, but the citations don't survive — a quiet credibility-data loss.
**Fix:** Accumulate citations from all grounded phases: `session.citations = [...(p1.sources||[]), ...(p2.sources||[])]` (dedup). Set it after Phase 2 (or build incrementally) so Phase 1 grounding URLs survive to send-pipeline.

### [MEDIUM] send-pipeline does not require briefData when attaching to an existing project — can wipe a project's brief with nulls
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 1123 (OR guard) and 1150-1156 (unconditional full overwrite of id8r_data on existing project)
**Problem:** The guard at line 1123 allows send-pipeline through if EITHER briefData OR packageData exists. When `existingProjectId` is passed (attaching to a PipΩr project), the code unconditionally calls `db.updateProjectId8r(project.id, { chosenConcept, researchSummary, packageData, briefData, citations })` (line 1150). If the session only has packageData (no brief) — or, after a checkpoint restore where briefData failed to restore — briefData/researchSummary are null, and updateProjectId8r does a full overwrite of id8r_data (UPDATE projects SET id8r_data = ?). For an existing project that already had a complete id8r_data blob (e.g. from the Ideas Vault or a prior Id8Ωr run), this silently clobbers the prior chosenConcept/researchSummary/briefData with the partial session's nulls. The Prime Directive recovery path is violated: a previously-saved brief is destroyed by an incomplete re-attach.
**Fix:** When existingProjectId is set, merge into the existing id8r_data rather than overwriting (read current, spread, only replace non-null fields), or require briefData before allowing an attach to an existing project.

### [MEDIUM] rescue redirect URL uses ?project= but pipr.html elsewhere uses ?load_project= — rescued project may not load
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** public/id8r.html session-rescue-btn handler: window.location.href = `/pipr.html?project=${data.project_id}` vs send-pipeline redirect_url `/pipr.html?load_project=${project.id}`
**Problem:** On successful rescue, the frontend redirects to `/pipr.html?project=${data.project_id}` (id8r.html session-rescue-btn handler). But everywhere else in this same file the PipΩr load URL is `/pipr.html?load_project=${project.id}` (send-pipeline redirect, line 1233). If pipr.html reads `load_project` (the canonical param used by send-pipeline), the rescue redirect lands on PipΩr with no project loaded — the entire point of the rescue (recovering creative state to a visible project) silently fails and the creator sees an empty PipΩr. This is the last-ditch recovery path for an API-credits/restart failure, so a param mismatch here defeats the safety net.
**Fix:** Change the rescue redirect to `/pipr.html?load_project=${data.project_id}` to match the canonical param, or verify pipr.html accepts both.

### [MEDIUM] Phase 3 VaultΩr keyword match is polluted by concept-brief boilerplate, producing false 'already covered' matches
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 912-917 (keyword extraction from full conceptBrief string incl. boilerplate)
**Problem:** Phase 3 builds keywords from `conceptBrief.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 4)` (line 912). conceptBrief is `Concept: "..." | Angle: ... | Why it works: ... | Context: ...` — so the keyword set includes boilerplate words like 'concept', 'angle', 'works', 'context', plus connective words from the why/headline. These generic tokens (length>4) match against footage title/tags/description, so almost any vault with descriptive metadata returns 'related video(s)' even when the topic is genuinely fresh. The creator gets a false 'you may have covered this' warning that adds a decision/doubt (violating the Secondary Directive) and undermines trust in the vault cross-reference. The threshold of word length 4 also lets 'video', 'about', etc. through.
**Fix:** Build keywords only from the chosen concept's headline/angle (not the labeled conceptBrief string), strip a stopword list including the label words ('concept','angle','works','context','video','about'), and require a minimum match count (e.g. >=2 matching keywords) before declaring a footage item related.

### [LOW] Concepts overwritten on restore-from-checkpoint race: /concepts reads stale restored session, /fast-concepts->choose can desync ids
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 727-738 (/choose clamps to 1-3 but fast-concepts produces 5 concepts with ids 4 and 5)
**Problem:** In /choose, when the choice is numeric 1-3 it indexes `session.concepts[choiceNum-1]` (line 730). But fast-concepts generates 5 concepts (ids 1-5) while the conversation /concepts path generates 3. The frontend renders by concept.id and calls chooseConcept(String(concept.id)). For a fast-concepts session the user can choose id 4 or 5, but /choose only accepts choiceNum in [1,3] (line 728) — choosing concept 4 or 5 falls through to the free-text 'blend' branch, creating a Custom Direction with headline=String(choice)='4', LOSING the actual concept object (angle/why/hook all discarded/empty). The chosen concept is silently replaced by a meaningless '4'. Research then runs on a near-empty concept.
**Fix:** Accept any numeric choice within `session.concepts.length` (e.g. `choiceNum >= 1 && choiceNum <= concepts.length`) and only fall back to free-text blend when the value is non-numeric.

### [LOW] /merge does not persist a checkpoint — merge sessions are not crash-safe and have no recovery path
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js /merge handler lines 1353-1370 (sessions.set with no persistSession call, unlike /start line 361 and /fast-concepts line 553)
**Problem:** Every other session-creating endpoint (/start, /fast-concepts) calls persistSession() right after sessions.set() so the work survives a restart. /merge (lines 1353-1370) calls sessions.set() but never calls persistSession(). If the server restarts after a merge but before the creator finishes choose/research, getOrRestoreSession finds no checkpoint and returns null → SESSION_EXPIRED, and the 3 generated merge concepts (a Claude call already paid for) are gone with no rescue (rescue-session relies on localStorage concepts, which merge does set, so partial recovery exists — but the in-memory crash-safety the other paths have is absent). Inconsistent with the documented 'checkpoint after every key step' guarantee.
**Fix:** Add `persistSession(sessionId);` after the sessions.set() in /merge.

### [LOW] Studio Intel age label computes NaN when si.created_at is missing/non-date, leaking 'NaNh ago' into prompts
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 483/487 and 649/653 (ageHours NaN path -> 'NaNd ago' in prompt)
**Problem:** In both /fast-concepts (line 483) and /concepts (line 649), ageHours is `Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(si.created_at)) / 3600000)`. If si.created_at is undefined or an unparseable string, `new Date(...)` is Invalid Date, the subtraction is NaN, and ageHours is NaN. The ternary `ageHours < 48` is false for NaN, so it renders `${Math.floor(NaN/24)}d ago` = 'NaNd ago' directly into the system prompt the model sees. Cosmetic but it injects garbage into the strategy prompt and could subtly confuse the model about data freshness.
**Fix:** Guard: `const ts = Date.parse(si.created_at); const ageHours = Number.isFinite(ts) ? Math.floor((Date.now()-ts)/3600000) : null;` and omit the age label when null.

### [LOW] Intermediate research checkpoints serialize the full live session including systemPrompt redundantly and can exceed sane size / drift from persistSession shape
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 857-862, 892-897, 931-936 (inline setCheckpoint with ...session) vs persistSession lines 52-74
**Problem:** Lines 858, 893, 932 call db.setCheckpoint(session_id,'id8r',{ ...session, researchResults:{...} }) directly, bypassing persistSession's curated shape. This spreads the entire live session object (systemPrompt, full messages array, fastInput, transient flags like restoredFromCheckpoint) into the checkpoint. It diverges from the canonical persistSession() shape, which is the source of the format drift behind finding id8r-1. On a restore mid-phase, getOrRestoreSession sets the session from this raw blob, which may carry restoredFromCheckpoint:true or other transient flags and an inconsistent researchResults (e.g. vault:null) that downstream code treats as 'research done'. The two checkpoint-writing code paths (persistSession vs inline) should produce identical shapes.
**Fix:** Set session.researchResults on the live session object then call persistSession(session_id) instead of an inline ad-hoc setCheckpoint, so the on-disk shape is always the canonical one.

### [LOW] callClaudeJSON failure on malformed JSON loses the whole concept/package/brief step with no partial recovery or repair attempt
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js lines 212-218 (callClaudeJSON single-pass parse, throws on any malformation)
**Problem:** callClaudeJSON (lines 212-218) strips one fenced code block then JSON.parse; on failure it throws. /concepts, /fast-concepts, /package, /brief, /merge all depend on it. A single trailing comma, prose preamble the regex misses (e.g. 'Here is the JSON:' before the fence), or truncation at max_tokens (package uses 2048, brief 4096 — large outputs can truncate) yields a hard 500 and the creator loses that generation entirely (the Claude call was already paid). For /brief this is the final step before sending to pipeline, so a truncated brief strands the user. No retry-with-repair, no extraction of the first {...} block.
**Fix:** Before throwing, attempt to extract the largest balanced {...} substring and re-parse; on max_tokens stop_reason, retry once with higher tokens. At minimum, return a structured error the frontend can offer a one-click retry for (package screen already has a retry button; brief screen does not).

### [HIGH] Concept/hook/package generation ignores the 190-transcript voice calibration that WritΩr uses
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /fast-concepts systemPrompt (~line 270), /concepts systemPrompt (~line 430), /package systemPrompt (~line 560); compare src/writr/claude.js:145 loadVoiceCalibrationBlock + REALITY_RULE/SLOP_RULE
**Problem:** Id8Ωr asks Claude to write 'the first 1-2 sentences of the video, in the creator's voice' (concepts) and 'First 15 seconds script' hooks (package), but it only feeds a one-line voiceSummary string ('Straight-talking, warm, never corporate') plus a hardcoded 'real numbers, never corporate' instruction. Meanwhile WritΩr injects loadVoiceCalibrationBlock() (built from data/voice-calibration.json — 190 transcripts, stored in kv_store as 'voice_calibration') plus REALITY_RULE and SLOP_RULE into every prompt. The result: Id8Ωr-generated hooks are written in a generic 'creator voice' and then handed to WritΩr, which rewrites them against the real calibrated voice — so the hooks the creator chooses in the Package step are often discarded/reworked downstream. The hook is the single most load-bearing creative artifact Id8Ωr produces, and it's the one place the real voice model is absent.
**Fix:** Import loadVoiceCalibrationBlock (and ideally REALITY_RULE) from src/writr/claude.js (or hoist into src/utils/claude.js) and append the calibration block to the system prompts in /fast-concepts, /concepts, /package, and /brief. The hooks the creator picks should already be in calibrated voice so WritΩr can keep rather than rewrite them — this closes the loop and reduces a decision (no re-choosing a hook that got rewritten).

### [HIGH] Grounded research citations are computed and stored but never shown to the creator in Id8Ωr
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** public/id8r.html onResearchEvent / renderPhaseBody (phase_result handler ~line 1490) — no citation rendering; backend sources at src/routes/id8r.js Phase 1/2 (results.youtube_sources / results.data_sources)
**Problem:** Gemini search grounding returns cited source URLs (groundingChunks → sources). These are captured as results.youtube_sources, results.data_sources, and saved to session.citations, then propagated to project-context.json and consumed by WritΩr/MailΩr as a citationsBlock. But the Id8Ωr research UI renders only the prose text plus a '🔍 Live' badge — there is zero rendering of the actual cited URLs (grep for 'citations'/'sources' in id8r.html returns nothing). The creator sees claims like statistics with no way to verify or click through to the source before standing in front of a camera repeating them. This undercuts research trust and violates the spirit of 'going on camera confidently' (deep_dive's stated goal).
**Fix:** Emit the per-phase sources array in the phase_result SSE payload (already on results.*_sources) and render a compact 'Sources' list of clickable links under each phase card. Bonus: dedupe and surface the top 3-5 domains as trust signals next to the Live badge.

### [MEDIUM] Dead 'phase_wait' countdown/musings UI — backend never emits the stage that drives it
**Dimension:** simplification
**Location:** public/id8r.html — phase_wait handler (~line 1537), MUSINGS array, activeCountdown/clearCountdown; src/routes/id8r.js:752 sseWait (unused)
**Problem:** The frontend carries a full interactive 'wait card' system: the MUSINGS array (10 reflective prompts), countdown numbers, a progress bar, a musing-rotation interval, a skip button, and clearCountdown() — all gated on ev.stage === 'phase_wait' (id8r.html:1537). The backend never sends a phase_wait event. It also defines sseWait(res, ms) (id8r.js:752) which is never called. So roughly 60+ lines of frontend logic and a backend helper are orphaned. The research flow no longer pauses with the 'each one needs a moment to breathe' card the research header still promises, creating a copy/UX mismatch.
**Fix:** Decide intent: either (a) delete the dead phase_wait UI + sseWait + the 'Each one needs a moment to breathe' subheading, or (b) if the reflective pause is desired product behavior, actually emit phase_wait between phases. Given the Prime Directive (reduce decisions/friction), recommend deleting it — the fast flow is better without an artificial countdown.

### [MEDIUM] Phase 3 VaultΩr overlap check uses naive substring keyword matching with no stop-word filtering
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /research Phase 3 (keywords/related computation, ~line 880-900)
**Problem:** The 'have you covered this before?' check splits conceptBrief into words >4 chars and does case-insensitive substring includes() against footage haystack. Two problems: (1) no stop-word/filler removal — words like 'video','about','really','homestead','creator' (all >4 chars and present in nearly every concept brief AND every footage title) will match almost everything, producing false 'you already covered this' warnings; conversely (2) substring matching on short stems causes spurious hits ('cost' matches 'costume'). Because conceptBrief includes the angle label and 'Why it works' boilerplate, generic words dominate. This makes the dedup signal noisy enough that the creator learns to ignore it — defeating the feature.
**Fix:** Filter keywords against a stop-word list, weight toward nouns/proper nouns from the chosen concept headline (not the full brief boilerplate), require word-boundary matches (\b) instead of substring includes, and rank related videos by match count so only genuinely overlapping videos surface. Consider reusing the chosen concept headline + top 2 user lines only, not the angle/why labels.

### [MEDIUM] No Post-Mortem brief injection into concept generation (known gap #5, obvious given pipeline)
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /fast-concepts and /concepts intelligence-block assembly (mirrrBlock/intelligenceBlock region); compare existing getActiveBrief()/getKv('studio_intel_brief') injections
**Problem:** Id8Ωr already injects MirrΩr evals, ClipsΩr patterns, Studio Intel, VectΩr active brief, and content_intelligence into concept generation — an impressive feedback web. But the Post-Mortem brief (CLAUDE.md Active Known Issue #5: 'Post-Mortem brief not yet injected into WritΩr/Id8Ωr') is absent. Post-Mortems are the most concrete 'what to do differently next time' signal in the whole system, and concept generation is exactly where that lesson should bias the next idea. This is the highest-leverage missing input for the 'reduce decisions' directive — it would steer the creator away from repeating mistakes at the idea stage rather than catching them in review.
**Fix:** Add a postMortemBlock: read the latest Post-Mortem brief (kv_store or postmortem route's stored output) and inject its 'do differently / avoid' takeaways into the concept system prompts the same way the VectΩr brief is injected. Bias concepts away from confirmed failure patterns.

### [MEDIUM] The original seed idea can fall out of the prompt context in longer conversations
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — getRecentMessages (~line 745) and its use in /concepts, /package, /brief
**Problem:** getRecentMessages keeps messages.slice(0,2) (the seed) plus the last 6 exchanges. For the conversation flow (/respond, /concepts, /package, /brief) the seed is preserved — good. But the seed pair is the synthetic 'Let's get started.' / first-question for conversational modes, NOT the creator's actual raw idea (which arrives as the first user reply, message index 2+). In a long Shape-It conversation, the creator's original framing idea (their first substantive message) is in the windowed-out middle, so /package and /brief — which call getRecentMessages — can lose the founding intent and drift toward whatever was discussed in the last 6 turns. This is a 'never break the creative thread' risk: the brief can quietly diverge from the idea the creator started with.
**Fix:** Anchor the creator's first substantive user message (messages.find(m=>m.role==='user' && m.content!=="Let's get started.")) explicitly into the prompt as a pinned 'Original idea:' line for /package and /brief, independent of the rolling window. For fast-pass sessions store fastInput is already pinned — apply the same pinning to conversational sessions.

### [LOW] Concept count mismatch: fast-pass returns 5, conversational returns 3 — UI copy hardcodes 'Three directions'
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** public/id8r.html — #screen-concepts .concepts-sub ('Three directions...'), .concept-grid grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); src/routes/id8r.js /fast-concepts (5) vs /concepts (3)
**Problem:** The default flow (/fast-concepts) returns 5 concepts, but the conversational /concepts endpoint returns exactly 3, and the concepts screen header is hardcoded 'CHOOSE YOUR ANGLE — Three directions based on your conversation.' When arriving via the fast path (the new default) the creator sees 5 cards under a header that says 'Three directions.' Minor but it's the first screen after the marquee fast flow, and the grid CSS is repeat(3,1fr) so 5 cards wrap 3+2 awkwardly.
**Fix:** Make the header copy dynamic based on conceptsData.length, and let the grid auto-fit (repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr))) so 3 or 5 both lay out cleanly. Optionally standardize on one count across both paths.

### [LOW] Checkpoint recovery banner reads legacy {phase1,phase2,phase3} keys that current research no longer writes in that shape
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** public/id8r.html — checkForCheckpoint() phasesFound + cp-restore-btn rebuild (reads cp.data.phaseN); backend writes researchResults:{youtube,data,vault} in src/routes/id8r.js /research
**Problem:** The frontend checkpoint-recovery banner (checkForCheckpoint, id8r.html) reads cp.data.phase1/phase2/phase3 to summarize 'what survived' and to rebuild the research feed. But the current /research endpoint checkpoints researchResults as {youtube, data, vault} (see the per-phase db.setCheckpoint calls and persistSession), NOT phase1/phase2/phase3. getOrRestoreSession even contains a migration shim for the OLD shape. So for any research interrupted today, cp.data.phase1 is undefined → the banner shows no phases / can't rebuild the feed, silently failing the crash-recovery promise that is central to the Prime Directive.
**Fix:** Update the recovery banner to read cp.data.researchResults.{youtube,data,vault} (with a fallback to legacy phaseN), so interrupted research is actually recoverable in the UI. Add a tiny test/manual check by killing the server mid-research.

### [MEDIUM] Research runs every time with no cache/skip — re-choosing a concept re-pays the full Gemini latency and cost
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /research (no cache check before Gemini calls); no skip-research path from concepts screen
**Problem:** If the creator picks concept A, runs research, goes back (or blends), and picks concept B, /research runs all 3 passes again from scratch — two live Gemini calls + a synthesis call. There's also no way to skip research for a creator who already knows their angle and just wants to package fast. Given the audience is a solo operator who values 'just works' speed, the always-full research pass is the slowest gate in the tool and is unconditional. Phase 1/2 results aren't keyed/cached by concept, so even identical re-runs re-fetch.
**Fix:** Cache Phase 1/2 results on the session keyed by a hash of conceptBrief and short-circuit if unchanged. Add a 'Skip research → Package now' option on the concepts screen for confident creators (research is enrichment, not a hard dependency for /package which already tolerates 'No research data.').

### [LOW] Research prompts hardcode creator-specific framing ('off-grid people','self-reliant'), violating Engine-vs-Soul separation
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /research Phase 1 Gemini prompt ('homesteading/financial-freedom creator with 725k TikTok and 54k YouTube') and Phase 2 Gemini prompt ('self-reliant/off-grid people')
**Problem:** The Gemini research prompts bake in creator-specific audience descriptors: Phase 1 hardcodes 'a homesteading/financial-freedom creator with 725k TikTok and 54k YouTube' and Phase 2 hardcodes 'self-reliant/off-grid people'. These duplicate (and can drift from) creator-profile.json and break the stated multi-tenancy foundation ('Never hardcode creator-specific data'). For Jason it works; for any other tenant the research is silently mis-targeted at homesteaders.
**Fix:** Replace hardcoded descriptors with getCreatorContext() values (niche, followerSummary, and a profile.audience_descriptor field). The fallback Claude system prompts already use _niche/_fs — make the Gemini prompts symmetric.

### [LOW] No SeedΩr round-trip: an idea promoted into Id8Ωr never updates its originating seed status, risking duplicate ideation
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js — /send-pipeline (no idea_id handling / no ideas.project_id update); ideas table has project_id REFERENCES projects(id)
**Problem:** When arriving via ?idea_id=N, Id8Ωr pre-fills the seed and Save-to-Vault can PATCH that idea. But the main forward path (/send-pipeline) creates a project and writes id8r_data, yet does NOT mark the originating SeedΩr idea as promoted/linked (it doesn't receive idea_id). So a seed the creator already developed still sits in SeedΩr looking untouched, inviting them to re-ideate the same idea — adding a decision/duplicate, contrary to the Secondary Directive. The ideas table even has a project_id FK column built for exactly this link.
**Fix:** Thread idea_id through fast-concepts/send-pipeline and, on project creation, set the originating idea's status='promoted' and project_id=newProjectId so SeedΩr reflects that the seed became a project.

### [HIGH] No Post-Mortem feedback loop into Id8Ωr despite an active-brief mechanism already existing
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js (/fast-concepts ~line 560 and /concepts ~line 600, alongside the existing getActiveBrief() injection block); db.getActivePostMortemBrief() in src/db.js:6128
**Problem:** Post-Mortem produces a structured, queryable feedback artifact: src/routes/postmortem.js locks a brief (root_cause, adjustments, avoid) into the post_mortem_briefs table, and db.js exposes db.getActivePostMortemBrief() returning the single active brief — architecturally identical to VectΩr's db.getActiveBrief(), which Id8Ωr DOES inject into concept generation (id8r.js /fast-concepts and /concepts). Id8Ωr injects MirrΩr evals, ClipsΩr patterns, Studio Intel, content_intelligence, and the VectΩr brief — but never calls getActivePostMortemBrief(). So the one tool whose entire purpose is 'what went wrong last time and what to avoid' has no path back into ideation. This is the exact loop the system's known-issues list flags ('Post-Mortem brief not yet injected into WritΩr/Id8Ωr'). The creator can repeat a diagnosed mistake one idea later with no signal. The fix is low-effort because the consumption pattern is already copy-pasteable from the VectΩr block right beside it.
**Fix:** In both /fast-concepts and /concepts, after the VectΩr getActiveBrief() injection, add a try/catch that calls require('../db').getActivePostMortemBrief() and, if present, appends a block to mirrrBlock: '## LAST POST-MORTEM (avoid repeating)\nRoot cause: <root_cause>\nAdjustments: <adjustments>\nAvoid: <avoid>\nDo not generate concepts that repeat this mistake; if an angle is in Avoid, only surface it with a materially different execution.' Mirror the same null-safe try/catch pattern used for getActiveBrief().

### [HIGH] SeedΩr→Id8Ωr handoff is client-side only and silently drops cluster, connections, notes, and brief_data
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** public/id8r.html handleIdeaSeed() IIFE (the ?idea_id branch); src/routes/id8r.js /fast-concepts (receives only input/mode/angle, no idea_id)
**Problem:** The idea record in the ideas table is rich: title, concept, angle, hook, notes, brief_data, cluster (ConstellΩr semantic group), and connections (weighted graph of related ideas with reasons). When the creator launches an idea into Id8Ωr via ?idea_id=N, the handoff happens entirely in id8r.html handleIdeaSeed(): it fetches /api/ideas/:id and flattens ONLY title, concept, hook into a freetext textarea blob, plus sets angle on the dropdown. The Id8Ωr backend (id8r.js) has no idea_id parameter anywhere and never reads the idea record server-side — grep confirms zero references to idea_id/getIdea/cluster/connections/brief_data in id8r.js. So the constellation context (this idea clusters with 'System Escape' and strongly connects to idea #456 via 'shared tension') and the creator's own notes are thrown away at the exact moment they'd be most useful for finding the angle. The full idea record is NOT used — only 4 of ~8 meaningful fields, and the relational/cluster intelligence is lost.
**Fix:** Pass idea_id through to the backend. Add an optional idea_id param to POST /api/id8r/fast-concepts; when present, server-side load the idea via db.getIdea(idea_id), and build an injection block from cluster, connections (resolve connected idea titles), and notes — e.g. 'SEED CONTEXT: This idea lives in cluster "<cluster>" and connects to: <title> (shared tension), ... Creator notes: <notes>'. Append it to the concept-generation system prompt. Persist idea_id on the session so /send-pipeline can set ideas.project_id to link the resulting project back to the originating seed.

### [MEDIUM] Id8Ωr never writes research results back to the originating SeedΩr idea record
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js /send-pipeline (creates/updates project, never touches ideas table); public/id8r.html saveToVault() (writes only chosenConcept to brief_data, omits researchSummary/citations)
**Problem:** When an idea is developed via ?idea_id=N, Id8Ωr can produce a full research bundle (researchSummary, citations, packageData, briefData). On /send-pipeline it writes all of this to projects.id8r_data and the project vault, and stamps ideas.project_id only when promotion happens through src/routes/ideas.js — but the Id8Ωr /send-pipeline path itself does NOT update the source idea: it never receives idea_id (see IT-2), so ideas.project_id, ideas.status, and ideas.brief_data are left stale for that record. The only write-back to SeedΩr is the manual 'Save to Vault' button (saveToVault() in id8r.html), which PATCHes /api/ideas/:idea_id with a thin brief_data containing chosenConcept + episodicContext — notably NOT the researchSummary or citations. So an idea the creator researched in Id8Ωr can still show as 'vault' status with no project link and no research attached. Research is persisted on the project, reusable by WritΩr/MailΩr/Lab, but the loop back to the idea it came from is broken.
**Fix:** Thread idea_id into /send-pipeline (per IT-2). After creating the project, call db.updateIdea(idea_id, { project_id: project.id, status: 'in_production' }) so the seed reflects it became a project. Separately, in saveToVault(), include session.researchSummary and citations in brief_data so a researched-but-not-yet-produced idea retains its findings in SeedΩr.

### [LOW] Research findings (web sources / audience insights) reach WritΩr and MailΩr but are invisible to VectΩr
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js (writes id8r_data per project); VectΩr strategy generation (consumes getActiveBrief output only, not project id8r_data research)
**Problem:** Id8Ωr persists research durably: researchSummary, citations (Gemini grounding URLs), and the YouTube-landscape/data phases land in projects.id8r_data, project-context.json, and id8r/research.json. WritΩr (id8rBlock), MailΩr (researchBlock + citationsBlock), and Lab all read this — good reuse. However VectΩr, the strategy tool, is a producer into Id8Ωr (getActiveBrief) but not a consumer of Id8Ωr's accumulated research. The audience insights and confirmed content gaps Id8Ωr discovers per-project never aggregate back into strategic direction, so VectΩr sets vector/focus/avoid without visibility into what research across recent projects actually surfaced. This is a one-directional link where a return path would close a strategy↔research loop.
**Fix:** When VectΩr builds a strategic session, query recent projects' id8r_data.researchSummary (and citations domains) to give the strategist a rollup of 'what research has been surfacing lately' before it sets the next vector. Low priority — improves strategic grounding but no creative-state loss if absent.

### [MEDIUM] PipΩr receives a content_angle string from Id8Ωr but it is written into the wrong project column (content_type)
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js /send-pipeline, db.updateProjectPipr({ content_type: pb.content_angle }) ~line 1145; brief schema defines both content_type and content_angle (~lines 1086-1088)
**Problem:** Id8Ωr's brief produces pipeline_brief.content_angle (one of financial|system|rockrich|howto|mistakes|lifestyle|viral) — a meaningful classification PipΩr/Mission Control would want. On /send-pipeline, db.updateProjectPipr() is called with { content_type: pb.content_angle } (id8r.js ~line 1145) — i.e. the ANGLE value is stored in the content_type field, while pipeline_brief.content_type (short_form|long_form|series), the actual format, is never persisted at all. So the angle and the format are conflated: PipΩr reads content_type expecting a format but gets an angle, and the format Id8Ωr generated is dropped. Downstream anything keying on content_type for short/long-form routing gets a wrong value. Id8Ωr produces both fields correctly; the handoff mis-maps them.
**Fix:** Map fields correctly: write pb.content_type (format) into the format column and store pb.content_angle in a dedicated content_angle/high_concept_angles column (the projects table already has high_concept_angles TEXT). Audit PipΩr's read of content_type to confirm it expects format, not angle, then split the two so neither is lost.

### [HIGH] Two parallel concept-generation paths (/fast-concepts and /respond→/concepts) duplicate ~150 lines of prompt-building
**Dimension:** simplification
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js: /fast-concepts (~line 380-560), /concepts (~line 580-740), /start (~line 300), /respond (~line 350)
**Problem:** The redesign added /fast-concepts (raw text → 5 concepts, the new default entry for shape_it/find_it/deep_dive/vault_first) but the old conversational path (/start → /respond loop → /concepts) is fully retained. Both endpoints rebuild nearly identical prompts: intelligenceBlock, mirrrBlock, VectΩr brief, Studio Intel injection, content-angles. /fast-concepts asks for 5 concepts; /concepts asks for 3. Episodic and merge modes also seed sessions and reuse /research→/package→/brief. The conversational path is now only reachable via the de-emphasized 'Want to think this through first?' link, yet it carries equal maintenance weight and an EXTRA decision (the creator must conduct a multi-turn Q&A before any concept appears). This is the core of the known redesign: the mind map is already gone from this code, but the conversational pass it implies is the remaining friction. Recommend making fast-concepts the only path and deleting /start, /respond, and /concepts, OR collapsing the two prompt builders into one shared function parameterized by concept-count.
**Fix:** Pick fast-concepts as the single ideation entry. Extract the shared prompt-context assembly (intelligence/mirrr/vectr/studio blocks) into one buildConceptContext() helper called by both until the conversational path can be removed. Delete /start, /respond, /concepts and the conversation screen once fast-pass is confirmed as default.

### [HIGH] Dead phase_wait countdown/musings machinery in frontend — backend never emits the event
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** public/id8r.html: MUSINGS array line 1466, phase_wait handler lines 1537-1582, clearCountdown 1622-1626, CSS .phase-wait-card/.countdown-number/.musing-text/.skip-btn lines 263-275; src/routes/id8r.js (no phase_wait emitter)
**Problem:** id8r.html contains ~90 lines of UI for an artificial 'breathe between phases' countdown: the MUSINGS array (10 reflective prompts), .phase-wait-card / .countdown-number / .musing-text CSS, the entire ev.stage==='phase_wait' handler with countdownInterval, musingInterval, progress bar, and a 'Skip wait →' button (id8r.html lines 1466, 1537-1582, CSS 263-272). The backend /research endpoint emits phase_start, phase_result, phase_note, retrying, and done — it NEVER sends phase_wait. Verified by grep: zero occurrences of phase_wait in id8r.js. This is leftover from an earlier design where research deliberately paused. It is pure dead weight, and worse, the unused MUSINGS/skip UI is exactly the kind of decision-adding ceremony the Prime/Secondary Directives say to cut.
**Fix:** Delete the phase_wait branch, MUSINGS array, activeCountdown/clearCountdown logic, and associated CSS. Also remove the now-orphaned sseWait() helper in id8r.js (line 752), which was the backend counterpart and is also never called.

### [HIGH] Frontend checkpoint-recovery banner reads phase1/phase2/phase3 — current code only writes researchResults.{youtube,data,vault}
**Dimension:** bug
**Location:** public/id8r.html: checkForCheckpoint IIFE (cp.data.phase1/phase2/phase3 references) vs src/routes/id8r.js lines 858-861 / 885-888 (writes researchResults.youtube/data/vault)
**Problem:** The 'Research saved from last session' recovery banner in id8r.html (the checkForCheckpoint IIFE) inspects cp.data.phase1/phase2/phase3 to decide what survived and to rebuild the research feed on 'Show saved research'. But the live /research endpoint checkpoints researchResults: { youtube, data, vault } (id8r.js lines 858-861, 885-888, etc.), never phase1/2/3. The backend getOrRestoreSession has a migration shim for the OLD phase1/2/3 shape, but the frontend banner has NO equivalent remap. Result: after a real server restart mid-research, the banner's phasesFound string is empty and 'Show saved research' renders nothing — the creator is told work was saved but sees an empty feed. This directly violates the Prime Directive (never break the creative thread without a working recovery path).
**Fix:** Update the frontend banner to read cp.data.researchResults?.youtube/data/vault (with a fallback to the legacy phase1/2/3 keys), and rebuild the feed from those. Mirror the backend migration shim so both shapes render.

### [MEDIUM] Minimum viable path counts ~6-8 decisions; 4 of them can be auto-defaulted to reduce to 2
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** public/id8r.html: mode-grid screen, package-columns (titles/thumbnails/hooks lists), checkPkg() gating package-continue-btn
**Problem:** From raw idea to project-ready, the fast path forces: (1) pick a mode card from 6 options, (2) optionally pick an angle, (3) type the idea, (4) choose 1 of 5 concepts (or blend), (5) read 3 research phases then click Package, (6) pick 1 of 3 titles AND (7) 1 of 3 thumbnails AND (8) 1 of 3 hooks, (9) choose Send to PipΩr vs WritΩr. The truly load-bearing decisions are: the idea text and which concept. Mode selection mostly just swaps prompt copy/intent — for the 4 conversational modes it could be inferred from the idea text or defaulted to shape_it with a quiet toggle, eliminating a whole screen. The package step forces THREE separate single-selects before a brief can be generated (package-continue-btn is disabled until all three are chosen) — this is the densest decision cluster and the one most ripe for auto-selecting Id8r's own top pick with one-click override.
**Fix:** Pre-select the first (AI-ranked best) title/thumbnail/hook so package-continue is enabled immediately; let the creator override only if they disagree. Default mode to shape_it and demote the 6-card mode picker to an optional 'change approach' affordance. Net path: type idea → pick concept → (auto-package) → brief → send. Decisions drop from ~8 to ~2.

### [MEDIUM] send-pipeline writes the same id8r_data context THREE times — DB column, project-context.json, and vault files
**Dimension:** inter-tool
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js /send-pipeline: db.updateProjectId8r(), addId8rContext(), vault.saveVaultData() block
**Problem:** On /send-pipeline, the session blob (chosenConcept, researchSummary, packageData, briefData, citations) is persisted via db.updateProjectId8r() into projects.id8r_data, AND via addId8rContext() into project-context.json, AND again as separate vault files (id8r/research.json, packages.json, brief.json, conversation.txt, VAULT-README.txt). Downstream consumers are inconsistent: WritΩr reads BOTH id8r_data and project-context.json; MailΩr and Lab read only id8r_data; project-vault serves the vault files. Three sources of truth for one payload means any future schema change must be applied in three places, and they can drift. This is overhead the creator never sees but that raises the cost of every downstream change.
**Fix:** Designate project-context.json (the stated 'single source of truth') as canonical and have WritΩr/MailΩr/Lab read it via one shared loader. Keep id8r_data only if a cheap DB-queryable copy is needed for Mission Control dedup; reduce the vault files to the human-readable VAULT-README plus conversation log, deriving the JSON files on demand.

### [MEDIUM] Creator must remember to 'Save to Vault' — the system should auto-persist creative state without an explicit click
**Dimension:** improvement
**Location:** public/id8r.html: saveToVault() and #save-vault-btn on the brief screen
**Problem:** The Vision Brief screen offers a manual '💡 Save to Vault' button (saveToVault) that writes back to SeedΩr ideas. Because send-pipeline already persists everything to the project, and checkpoints persist mid-flow, the explicit Save-to-Vault is a remember-to-do-it step that adds a decision and risks the creator thinking work is lost if they don't click it. Per the Secondary Directive (reduce decisions) and Prime Directive (never lose creative state), saving should be automatic, not a button the creator has to remember. The 'rescue-session' and checkpoint machinery already exist precisely because state-loss is the feared failure — yet the happy path still leans on a manual save.
**Fix:** Auto-save the brief to the originating SeedΩr idea (or create one) as soon as the brief renders, showing a passive 'Saved' indicator instead of an action button. Keep an explicit control only as a redundant affordance, not the primary persistence mechanism.

### [LOW] Research is a fixed linear 3-phase + summarize pipeline the creator cannot skip or shorten
**Dimension:** simplification
**Location:** src/routes/id8r.js /research (4-phase linear stream); public/id8r.html chooseConcept()→startResearch() auto-chains with no skip
**Problem:** Every chosen concept runs Phase 1 (YouTube landscape), Phase 2 (data/facts), Phase 3 (vault cross-ref), then Phase 4 summarize — with global keepalive pings during 15-20s Gemini calls. There is no way for the creator to say 'I already know the landscape, just package it.' For a creator who described a concrete idea (e.g. '$47 chicken coop'), the YouTube-landscape pass may add latency without changing the decision to film. The research is valuable but mandatory; offering a 'skip research → package now' shortcut on the concepts screen would honor the Secondary Directive for the cases where the creator is already decided.
**Fix:** Add a secondary action on the concepts screen ('Skip research, package now') that jumps chosen concept straight to /package. Research stays the default; the shortcut serves the already-decided creator and removes forced latency.
